question: The festival of Ram Navami is celebrated in the Hindu month of ________ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chaitra.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chaitra (March-April):** 

 
 
• In the Hindu calendar, the** first month is Chaitra** and is highly fortunate.
 
• Occurs in **March or April on the Gregorian calendar**.
 
• The Hindu New Year, known in **Maharashtra as Gudi Padwa**, in **Andhra Pradesh and Telangana as Ugadi**, and in **other parts of India as Chaitra Navratri**, ushers in the month.
 
• The month is** linked to fresh starts, development, and wealth** as well as the **start of the spring season.**
 
 
 
• **Ram Navami:**
 
 
• Ram Navami is a Hindu festival that** celebrates the birth of Lord Rama**, one of the **most revered deities in Hinduism.**
 
• It** falls on the ninth day of Shukla Paksha in the Hindu month of Chaitra**, which usually falls in March or April according to the Gregorian calendar.
 
• The festival is celebrated with great enthusiasm and devotion by Hindus all over the world, with special prayers, fasting, and offerings being made to Lord Rama and his consort Sita.
 
• The celebrations include processions, singing of devotional songs, and recitation of the Ramayana, the epic story of Lord Rama's life and deeds.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ashwin (September-October):** 

 
 
• According to the Hindu calendar, **Ashwin, the seventh month**, is connected to the** celebration of Navratri,** a holiday **honoring the divine feminine force.**
 
• Additionally, the month is linked to the** celebration of Dussehra, a festival honoring Lord Rama's victory over the demon king Ravana. **
 
 
 
• **Kartik (October-November):**
 
 
• The Hindu calendar's** eighth month, Kartik**, is linked to the **celebration of Diwali, the festival of lights.**
 
• The month is also linked to the **observance of Karva Chauth,** a festival **honoring the marriage union of husband and wife.**
 
• It is also **linked with festival of Bhai Dooj.**
 
 
 
• **Phalguna (February-March):**
 
 
• The** Hindu calendar's twelfth and final month, Phalguna**, occurs in** February or March on the Gregorian calendar.**
 
• It is the **month of Holi**, the widely renowned **festival of colors** that ushers in **India's springtime.**
 
• People of all ages celebrate the holiday with great excitement, playing with colors, indulging in traditional sweets and delicacies, and praying to Lord Krishna.
 
• In addition to Holi, Phalguna is the site of several significant celebrations,** including Shivratri and Holika Dahan.**
